about: DEV set for the brief review (model check on brief text, shared/safety/brief-review.json), 2026-10-24. Written by the safety builder; the review prompt may be shaped on it (as shapes, never quoting it). Includes the T-L1 DEV lines (sets/dev-lint-ai.json) plus crisis-line and manipulation instructions and multi-line snippets. Blind counterpart: heldout-brief-review.json (written by a separate agent, scored once).
